'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a deceased [[NPC]] that can be found in the [[Lost Beyond]]  as a Reverberation after completing the {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}.

He can be seen talking to '''Noemie''' in the morning and dancing with her at night on the cliff. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Luneau''' Won't you at least consider my suggestion?

:'''Luneau:''' I have some spare cash on hand. You can borrow my money and pay me back later.
:'''Noemie:''' Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept this. I've also returned everything Phrolova's given me.
:'''Noemie:''' It's infuriating. She bought her first violin by herself with savings from her job. Does she think I can't do the same?
:'''Luneau:''' I'm sure that's not what she meant.
:'''Noemie:''' But I'm not angry, really. I only want you all to trust me. Even though it'll take a while, I want to buy a new instrument on my own.
:'''Luneau:''' Still... I'd like to help.
:'''Noemie:''' Then you can accompany me to the city and help me pick out an instrument after I've saved enough.
:'''Luneau:''' Alright, it's a deal!
{{Dialogue End}}
